response.sql:
WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysed_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(analysed_count) AS overall_count,
         AVG(analysed_count) AS avg_count
  FROM type_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT tc.analysed_count,
         1.0 * tc.analysed_count / totals.overall_count AS share
  FROM type_counts AS tc
  CROSS JOIN totals
  WHERE tc.analysed_count > totals.avg_count
)
SELECT tc.tradekind,
       tc.analysed_count,
       1.0 * tc.analysed_count / totals.overall_count AS share_of_overall_total,
       NULL AS combined_count,
       NULL AS average_share,
       NULL AS average_excess_over_type_average
FROM type_counts AS tc
CROSS JOIN totals
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Combined above-average trader types',
       SUM(analysed_count),
       NULL,
       SUM(analysed_count),
       AVG(share),
       AVG(analysed_count - totals.avg_count)
FROM above_average
CROSS JOIN totals

assumptions.assumption: The request's combined figures are presented as a final summary row alongside the per-trader-type results; shares are proportions of the total analysed records, and the average is unweighted across trader types.
